# Megastera agent manifest

Megastera is a backend-Planet game powered by Megapot tickets on Base mainnet. The current
sources of truth are AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/STATUS.md, and
docs/OPERATIONS.md. Historical handoffs and plans are not active requirements.

## Runtime invariants

- Base mainnet chain ID is 8453; do not restore Base Sepolia runtime switches.
- `TICKET_SOURCE` remains `MEGASTERA`.
- Contract addresses and the approved referrer are centralized in `src/config/contracts.ts`.
- Planet authority is a finalized, server-verified canonical Megapot receipt.
- Planets and GIFs are backend database records, not NFTs or browser-generated authority.
- Mining is read-only from persisted `generatedAt` and base rate.
- Secrets never use `VITE_*` names and never enter the repository.

## Repository map

- `src/config/contracts.ts`: Base mainnet contracts, explorer, source, referrer.
- `src/hooks/`: dynamic Megapot reads and wallet transaction orchestration.
- `src/lib/api.ts`: production Data API base and client behavior.
- `api/index.ts`: the only Vercel Function.
- `server/api/`: Hono routes, receipt verification, persistence, mining, leaderboard.
- `server/proxy.ts`: mainnet Megapot Data API proxy with server-only key.
- `prisma/schema.prisma` and `prisma/migrations/`: database schema and migration history.
- `packages/planet-generator/`: deterministic traits and GIF rendering.
- `vercel.json`: Vite output, API catch-all, and SPA routing.

## Verification

Run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm db:generate`,
`pnpm db:validate`, and `pnpm --filter @megaplanets/planet-generator golden`.

Megapot protocol source of truth: https://llms.megapot.io/
